activities.description: Wenona introduces Kiana Gregory from the Progressive Change Campaign Committee (PCCC).
Explains PCCC's support and belief in Wenona's ability to win. Audience applauds.
Highlights the potential of sending a second progressive representative from Arizona to Congress and calls for financial contributions.
Wenona reiterates the need for people-powered donations and PCCC's support, expressing confidence in winning the race.

characterInteraction.description: Introduces Kiana to the audience, creating a connection between local supporters and national organizations. Wenona then directly engages the audience in her fundraising pitch.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The presence of Kiana Gregory and the donation envelopes signal a shift from building awareness to actively seeking financial support, a critical step in any political campaign.

youtube_description: Wenona Benaly Baldenegro addressed the Arizona Democratic Party's statewide committee on Jan. 21, 2012. Benaly Baldenegro is running for the Democratic Party nomination to the US House of Representatives. She is running for CD1.
